title: File:Experiemnt for studying how robots can help children learn - Shall We Play a Game? - Honda Research Institute, 2009-01-12 19.09.17 (by Steve Jurvetson).jpg
art: Steve Jurvetson from Menlo Park, USA
desc:
Shall We Play a Game?

An experiment is about to begin at the Honda Research Institute studying how robots can help children learn.

A headband tracking camera is lying on the table, and will record where the child diverts their attention – do hand and head gestures distract or aid in communication?
